title: I had zero Blender/Godot experience. Claude Opus 5 built me a full medieval Prague action RPG in ~4 hours
author: Any-Blacksmith-2054
selftext:
Wanted to share an experiment. I installed Blender and Godot, knew nothing about either, and tried to see how far I could get by letting Claude Opus 5 do the actual work.

The result is **Alchemists of Prague**, a small action RPG set in medieval Prague. You play as Václav, a knight fighting evil alchemists, clay golems and skeletons across Old Town Square, Charles Bridge, Malá Strana and Vyšehrad. There’s a market where you trade and upgrade your sword, a day/night cycle with lanterns lighting up at night, and you can throw enemies out of windows, because defenestration is basically a Prague tradition.

How I did it:

* Generated concept art for every location, character and UI screen (day and night versions) in one consistent style, roughly Gothic 1/2 vibes
* Split the work into 5 task files: environment, characters, empty levels, scene assembly, gameplay in Godot
* Told it to work fully autonomously, no questions. It modeled everything in Blender via Python scripts, did the animations, built the levels and programmed combat, trading and saves. Sounds came from free CC0 sources

Numbers:

* \~4 hours of Opus working on its own
* \~25% of my weekly limit on a $20 subscription
* Builds for Windows, Android and web

Play it in the browser: [https://severance.lol/4/](https://severance.lol/4/)

It’s not perfect, but I’m honestly surprised it works at all. Happy to answer questions about the process or share the task files.
